purpose: Provenance manifest for the forensic paper-setting evolution audit. It distinguishes primary official URLs from independently hosted reproductions and records access limitations instead of treating a mirror as an official document.

text_extraction.coverage: Every PDF preserved under data/research/source-pdfs/ has a corresponding extracted UTF-8 text artifact under the matching source-text path.

documents.title: TGPSC Group-I Preliminary Test, General Studies and Mental Ability, 09 June 2024
documents.official_paper_key_access: Candidate-login delivery. Public URL found through archived page: https://websitenew.tspsc.gov.in/viewKeyObjections?accessId=Kgsoy895EREIjhfjisd. It returned access denied during retrieval.
documents.ingestion: PDF is an image-only 52-page bilingual scan. Page 1 was visually inspected; the selectable public transcription was downloaded from Scribd and parsed into 150 English question stems.
documents.confidence: Question text corroborated by two independent public reproductions; official final master key itself was not publicly retrievable.

documents.title: TGPSC Group-IV Services Paper-I, General Studies, 01 July 2023
documents.retrieval_result: Both historical official-host URLs failed DNS resolution in the retrieval environment.
documents.ingestion: HTML text identifies itself as the Paper-I Final Master Key, notification 19/2022, code 22191. It lists deleted questions and option changes.
documents.confidence: Official URL provenance established, but retained artifact is a reproduction because the official host is retired/unreachable.

documents.title: TGPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Paper-I, General Studies, 26 February 2023
documents.official_delivery: Question paper and response/key were originally delivered through TSPSC candidate services. The public official archive no longer exposes a retrievable document.
documents.ingestion: Catalog and public paper listing inspected. This paper is a corroborating comparator only and is not part of the percentage matrix.
documents.confidence: Metadata corroborated; no final master key artifact was publicly downloadable without a candidate session.

documents.title: TGPSC Lecturers in Government Polytechnics, September 2023
documents.official_delivery: Question papers, candidate response sheets, and provisional keys were delivered by login. Final keys were released after the objection process.
documents.ingestion: Public record inspected for exam dates, key release and objection workflow. Individual discipline papers are not combined into one invalid aggregate.
documents.confidence: Metadata corroborated; final-key download endpoint was not publicly retrievable.

documents.title: TSLPRB SI and Constable preliminary and final written papers, 2022-2023
documents.official_delivery: Question papers and response sheets were candidate-login/public-homepage releases at the time of examination. Official final keys are now recovered from the board's public S3 bucket and archived board-host URLs.
documents.ingestion: The project-maintained extracted_question_paper_json corpus was inspected in full. It is identified in AGENTS.md as the clean structured ground-truth source used to build the verified PYQ master. Retrieved official final and preliminary keys were downloaded, checksum-verified and text-extracted separately.
documents.confidence: Full question text is available locally. SI and PC official key artifacts for 2022-2023 are now independently retrievable and preserved under data/research/source-pdfs/.

documents.title: TSLPRB SI and Constable preliminary and mains papers, 2015-2018
documents.official_delivery: Historical question PDFs are not exposed by the current TGPRB portal, but official board-host key files were recovered through archived board URLs.
documents.ingestion: The project-maintained extracted_question_paper_json corpus was inspected in full for each matrix paper. Recovered official key PDFs were downloaded, checksum-verified and text-extracted separately.
documents.confidence: Full question text is available locally. The retained key artifacts provide primary-source answer-key provenance; the local structured question corpus remains the text source for the format matrix.

retrieved_official_key_artifacts.note: The directory preserves the six retrieved files with content-corrected local names and individual SHA-256 values. One archived URL labelled as an SC file resolves to a board PDF whose own title identifies SI Communication final key; the title, not the guessed filename, controls classification.

retrieved_nonofficial_reproductions.status: Independent reproduction of the official key; not treated as an official-host download.
